name: my-win-app
description: 现代化 Electron + Vue 3 + TypeScript 桌面应用
author: Your Name

scripts.electron:dev: npm run compile:main && concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5180 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5180 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run type-check && npm run compile:main && vite build && electron-builder build --dir
scripts.build:prod: npm run type-check && npm run compile:main && vite build && electron-builder build --publish=never
scripts.build:portable: npm run type-check && npm run compile:main && vite build && electron-builder build --publish=never --win=portable
